## P4.17 — final operation invariant model

Risk: authorization/read consistency. This model documents the executor's concrete before-order finding and the complete correction scope for the second review; it adds no frozen spec requirement or owner authority.

| Operation / resource | Invariant / enforcement | Interference / evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Static PolicyOnly / assignment DB | static mode dispatched before resolving source; no schema/state/dynamic/assignment calls or transaction guard | existing FenceTest with an open authority transaction and 0 calls |
| Static Grants / DB and external grants | existing readContributions/readSource whole-capability fences remain unchanged | existing FenceTest controls, no new root retries of their terminal ConsistencyError |
| Dynamic Prepare / definitions | exact panel/tenant, Grants only, reserved static/prefix names; no code roles/modes from DB | DynamicCatalogTest A/B/global/foreign panel/shadow/prefix/pattern controls |
| Dynamic before / grant-only sources | boundary/before precedes assignment capabilities; definition read shares its T_before with later authority | DynamicFenceTest before Deny: 0 assignment reads, 0 external grant callbacks |
| Dynamic authority / all consumed sources | one pinned DB session, no nested fence; all definitions/grants/roles materialized before final T_after | mutation during role read and another source callback require full retry |
| Retry / operation frame | new overlay/frame/Trace/ReadAttempt/state-map, original request and one now; no invalid DB state or qualified witness reused | exact two-attempt read sequence, identical before now, empty final grants, disappeared action unknown |
| Final observation / after hooks | confirm consumed revisions before after; after sees one accepted result or the final three-attempt ConsistencyError | before/grants instability tests assert before counts 2/3 and after count 1 |
| Read route / DB PDO | Primary or Default selected once per attempt, same schema/state/definitions/grants handle | separate-PDO SQLite test; existing StorageReadSession rejects raw/framework unknown transactions and reconnect |

Drivers: final P4.17 behavioral checks use SQLite :memory:. The new coordinator uses the existing driver-independent pinned StorageReadSession and Query Builder. Prior P4.4 server-engine qualification is inherited evidence for that unchanged layer, not new P4.17 scoped/server race acceptance. Real scoped end-to-end and engine/race controls retain owning items P4.18/P4.21. Default does not promise strict Primary freshness.

No writes/locks/caches are added by the reader. Synthetic writes use Storage::mutate and touch to model concurrent committed definition/grant changes. Malformed/error snapshots are confirmed before accepting a denial; a stale snapshot retries rather than hiding changed authority. An error reading the final state gives SourceError, never Allow.
